# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 17 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 17 | **Condition:** moderately damaged

---

**17:1** I thank You, O Lord, for You have enlightened my face for Your covenant,

**17:2** and from [...] I seek You, and sure as the dawn You appear to me as perfect light.

**17:3** But they among Your people [...] led them astray, and spokesmen of falsehood smoothed their way,

**17:4** causing them to stumble without understanding. For [...] their deeds are done in madness.

**17:5** I am despised by them; they accord me no worth

**17:6** even when You show Your strength through me. They drove me from my land

**17:7** like a bird from its nest, and all my companions and friends

**17:8** have been driven far from me. They regard me as a broken vessel.

**17:9** They -- interpreters of lies and seers of deceit --

**17:10** have plotted wickedness against me, to exchange Your instruction inscribed upon my heart

**17:11** for smooth things to Your people. They withhold the drink of knowledge from the thirsty

**17:12** and give them vinegar to drink, so that they gaze upon

**17:13** their error, behaving madly at their feasts, trapped in their nets.

**17:14** But You, O God, You despise every purpose of Belial,

**17:15** and Your counsel alone stands, and the purpose of Your heart is established forever.

**17:16** They are pretenders, plotting the schemes of Belial;

**17:17** they seek You with a double heart and are not established in Your truth.

**17:18** A root bearing poison and wormwood is in their thoughts,

**17:19** and in the stubbornness of their hearts they go about; they seek You among idols,

**17:20** and the stumbling block of their iniquity they set before their faces.

**17:21** They come to seek You from the mouth of lying prophets, seduced by error.

**17:22** With stammering lips and a foreign tongue

**17:23** they speak to Your people, making all their works foolish through deceit.

**17:24** For they have not chosen the way of Your heart, and they have not listened to Your word;

**17:25** they said of the vision of knowledge: It is not established! And of the way of Your heart: It is not that!

**17:26** But You, O God, will answer them, judging them in Your might

**17:27** according to their idols and the multitude of their transgressions,

**17:28** so that they are caught in their own schemes, they who turned aside from Your covenant.

**17:29** You shall cut off in judgment every man of deceit, and seers of error shall be found no more.

**17:30** For there is no foolishness in any of Your works, and no deceit in the purpose of Your heart.

**17:31** Those who are according to Your pleasure shall stand before You forever,

**17:32** and those who walk in the way of Your heart shall be established for eternity.

**17:33** As for me, when I hold fast to You, I rise and stand firm against those who despise me,

**17:34** and my hand is against all who mock me. They do not esteem me

**17:35** even when You show Your might through me. For You appeared to me in Your strength at the break of dawn,

**17:36** and You have not covered my face with shame [...] who seek You in the council of community [...]

**17:37** [...] standing before You [...] forever.

---
*SOPHIA notes: Column 17 is a polemical hymn likely reflecting the Teacher of Righteousness's conflict with rival religious authorities. SOPHIA retained EMET's "smooth things" -- the crucial Qumran term (chalaqot). "Interpreters of lies" and "seers of deceit" preserved as technical terms. See disagreement log for 8 divergences.*
